plain_description.what: Re-runs an earlier certificate check (CERT-UNDER-FILTER) over 200 random draws instead of the one registered draw. It counts how often the result still holds and builds an interval that includes this extra randomness. No new calls.
plain_description.why: It asks whether an earlier trust result depended on one lucky random draw.
plain_description.information: A high hold rate would mean the earlier result is robust. A low one would mean it depends on the draw. Result: descriptive only. The result holds in 49 of 200 draws (about 25%), and the wider interval includes zero. So it held at the registered draw but is marginal across draws, and even that band depends on the bootstrap seed. The earlier verdict cannot and does not change. A later ruling classes the underlying judged data as history.
